name: wind atlas
summary: Six-hourly ERA5 10 m U/V samples classified into eight 45-degree meteorological wind-from sectors; frequency, conditional speed, calm and gale probability
aggregation: sample classification then exact merge of integer counts and floating speed sums
encoding: legacy wind/fefe plus WEX1 calm/gale sidecar

name: ocean surface current
summary: OSCAR Final V2 daily total-current U/V monthly climatology
target_grid: 1/3 degree longitude, 1/3 degree latitude from 80N to 80S
aggregation: missing-aware component mean followed by component-wise bilinear resampling
encoding: legacy current/1 signed 8-bit components at 0.05 kn

name: mean sea-level pressure
summary: ERA5 monthly mean sea-level pressure climatology
aggregation: calendar-month arithmetic mean then bilinear resampling

name: air temperature
aggregation: calendar-month arithmetic mean then bilinear resampling
encoding: uint8, 0.333333 degree C, offset -45 degree C, 255 missing
missing_policy: finite values outside the legacy representable range are missing

name: relative humidity
summary: Relative humidity derived from ERA5 monthly 2 m temperature and dew point
aggregation: WMO-style saturation-vapour-pressure ratio, calendar-month mean, bilinear resampling

name: precipitation
summary: ERA5 monthly mean total-precipitation rate converted to mean mm/day
aggregation: rate conversion, calendar-month arithmetic mean, bilinear resampling
overflow_policy: finite values above 50.8 mm/day saturate at 50.8; five target cells in this build

name: total cloud cover
aggregation: calendar-month arithmetic mean then bilinear resampling

name: sea-surface temperature
summary: NOAA OISST v2.1 monthly sea-surface-temperature climatology
aggregation: calendar-month missing-aware arithmetic mean then bilinear resampling
encoding: uint8, 0.2 degree C, offset -2 degree C, 255 missing

name: tropical cyclone tracks
summary: IBTrACS v04r01 main-track positions at six-hour synoptic times
aggregation: records grouped by storm and legacy theatre
wind_convention: USA_WIND homogeneous one-minute series where present; unavailable otherwise

name: bathymetric context
summary: GEBCO_2026 wet-cell median depth, contextual and explicitly not for navigation
source_units: m relative to mean sea level
aggregation: median of negative source elevations in each target cell

name: lightning
summary: Retained observational NASA LIS/OTD HRMC v2.3.2013 monthly flash climatology

name: ENSO classification
summary: NOAA CPC historical three-month Oceanic Nino Index based on ERSSTv6
